'''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is an ancient '''kofun''' (Kofun) located in {{ill|Shin'ichi|ja|新市町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shin'ichi, Hiroshima|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11502125}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|en|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|qid=Q661038|lt=Fukuyama, Hiroshima}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. While its type is '''not fully confirmed''', it is '''presumed to be a keyhole-shaped kofun (前方後円墳)'''. The mound has not been Historic Site1 as a historical site, but burial goods traditionally associated with the site, including a '''Sankakuen shinjukyo (三角縁神獣鏡, triangular-rimmed deity-and-beast mirror)''' and an '''iron axe''', are '''Hiroshima Prefectural {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|en|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|qid=Q1188622|lt=Important Cultural Property}}'''.

== Overview ==
[[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of the Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)}}{{small|On display at the '''{{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki-no-oka Museum|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11484763}}'''}}]]
Shiozakiyama Kofun is situated '''on a hill overlooking the confluence of the Ashida River (芦田川) and Kamiya River (神谷川)''' in eastern Hiroshima Prefecture. The site was '''excavated in 1827 (Bunsei 10, Edo period)''' and is recorded in '''"Seibi Meiku" (西備名区)'''. However, '''no modern archaeological investigations''' have been conducted.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}<ref name="sign"/>

The mound has been '''heavily altered and eroded''', but based on estimates, it was originally '''a keyhole-shaped tumulus with a total length of approximately 30 meters''', with a '''rear circular section of 17 meters in diameter'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}} According to the '''historical records from Seibi Meiku''', the tomb likely contained '''a stone chamber (石槨, sekkaku)'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}

During the Edo-period excavation, '''a Sankakuen shinjukyo mirror (三角縁神獣鏡)''' and '''an iron axe''' were reportedly found. The tumulus is estimated to have been '''built in the 4th century''' during the '''early Kofun period''', making it one of the '''earliest keyhole-shaped kofun''' in the '''Bingo region'''.{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (古墳)|1989}}<ref name="sign"/>

The excavated mirror and iron axe were Historic Site1 as '''Hiroshima Prefectural {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|en|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|qid=Q1188622|lt=Important Cultural Property}}''' in 1981 and 1982. Today, a '''grave for Chiba Shuri-no-Shin (千葉修理之進)''' stands at the presumed rear circular section of the mound.

'''Shiozakiyama Kofun''' (潮崎山古墳) is a {{ill|Kofun|en|Kofun|qid=Q1141225|lt=Kofun}} located in {{ill|Shin'ichi|ja|新市町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinichi, Hiroshima|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11502125}}, {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|en|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|qid=Q661038|lt=Fukuyama, Hiroshima}}, Hiroshima Prefecture, Japan. The tumulus is assumed to be keyhole-shaped and dates to the {{ill|Kofun period|en|Kofun period|qid=Q459939|lt=Kofun period}} (4th century). It is not Historic Site1 as a historic site but is notable for its burial goods, a mirror, and an iron axe, both Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|en|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|qid=Q1188622|lt=Important Cultural Property}}.

== Overview ==
[[File:潮崎山古墳出土 三角縁神獣鏡 (複製).JPG|thumb|200px|right|{{center|Replica of a {{ill|Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}}}}{{small|Displayed at the {{ill|Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Hiroshima Prefectural Miyoshi Fudoki Hill|lt=Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum|ja|広島県立みよし風土記の丘|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Miyoshi Fudoki Hill Museum}}.}}]]
The kofun is located on a hill overlooking the confluence of the {{ill|Ashida River|en|Ashida River|qid=Q2577132|lt=Ashida River}} and the Kamiya River in the eastern part of Hiroshima Prefecture. It was excavated in the late Edo period in 1827 ({{ill|Bunsei|en|Bunsei|qid=Q1327119|lt=Bunsei}} 10) as recorded in the historical text {{ill|Q109361032|ja|西備名区|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Saibimeiku|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q109361032}}{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}<ref name="description_board"/>. However, no modern archaeological investigations have been conducted.

The tumulus has been extensively leveled, and its original type is unclear. It is estimated to have been keyhole-shaped, with a total length of approximately 30 meters and a circular rear section diameter of about 17 meters{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. According to the historical text, the burial facility was a stone chamber{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}. burial goods traditionally associated with the site include a {{ill|Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror|ja|三角縁神獣鏡|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sankakuen shinjūkyō|13=User:Immanuelle/Triangular-Rimmed Divine Beast Mirror}} and an iron axe. The kofun is considered one of the earliest tumuli in the {{ill|Bingo Province|en|Bingo Province|qid=Q1049113|lt=Bingo Province}} region, possibly the oldest keyhole-shaped kofun in the area, and is of significant historical importance{{Sfn|Shiozakiyama Kofun (Kofun)|1989}}<ref name="description_board"/>.

The mirror and axe were Historic Site1 as Hiroshima Prefecture {{ill|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|en|Important Cultural Property (Japan)|qid=Q1188622|lt=Important Cultural Property}} in 1981 and 1982, respectively<ref name="hiroshima_prefecture"/>. Today, the assumed circular rear section of the mound is the site of the grave of Chiba Shūrin no Shin.

== Historic Site ==
=== Hiroshima Prefecture-Historic Site1 Historic Site ===
* Important designation1 (Tangible designation1)
** Mirror and iron axe (Traditionally associated with Shiozakiyama Kofun) (Archaeological burial goods) - Designated November 6, 1981, with additional Historic Site and name change on February 23, 1982.<ref name="hiroshima_prefecture">[https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/site/bunkazai/bunkazai-data-202060060.html Mirror and Iron Axe from Shiozakiyama Kofun] (Hiroshima Prefecture Board of Education "Hotline Education Hiroshima").</ref>
*** Mirror: Diameter 22.0 cm, thickness 0.2-0.3 cm<ref name="hiroshima_prefecture"/>. Mold-identical to a mirror from {{ill|Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)|ja|国分寺古墳 (倉吉市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kokubunji Kofun (Kurayoshi)}} in {{ill|Tottori Prefecture|en|Tottori Prefecture|qid=Q133935|lt=Tottori Prefecture}}{{Sfn|Description Board}}.
*** Iron axe: Length 24.8 cm, head width 5.5 cm, central width 6.0 cm, blade width 7.0-7.5 cm, thickness 1-4 cm<ref name="hiroshima_prefecture"/>.
